shortDescription: List ServiceNow service catalogs along with categories and items

options.name: categories
options.description: If set to V(true), the categories will be fetched from ServiceNow.

options.name: items_info
options.description: List of options for fetching service catalog items. Set to V(full), if the whole item will be fetched.

options.name: items_query
options.description: Query for the item content. For more information, please refer to U(https://developer.servicenow.com/dev.do#!/reference/api/utah/rest/c_ServiceCatalogAPI#servicecat-GET-items)

options.name: sys_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the record to retrieve.
